about: B1d (16 Nov 2026): the 25 wrong-product conversations of sim-test 43781701377 (CX1's run on main, the latest; 18 in B1c's run 43776071899 before it), read one by one, with what must happen instead and the test that holds it. `readings`: the model's reading against the customer's words, tidied by code (evals/test/b1d-counts.test.ts); `packs`: a count against the chosen pack (packSizeCount); the flows are in test/db/ordering-b1d.test.ts. Invented customers.

customer: [voice note, transcript as received: "مرحبا اتنين domo sugar vanillinخمس غرام واتنين edita bake rolz زيتون تنين وخمسين غرام وبدي ياهم عالبيت بغريفة"]

cases.wrong: «اتنين domo sugar vanillin خمس غرام»: «خمس غرام» (the 5 g size) was read as its own line and asked as a second question; its tap added a third vanillin.
cases.expect: A line that is only a weight or a volume joins the line before it: one question, and the tap keeps the 2.
cases.tested_by: reading: sim-008-measure-line; flow: ordering-b1d «a size said after an item»

cases.wrong: «بامبرز اوي اوي مقاس ٦ (١٦-٣٠ كيلو) ٣٢ حبة»: the tap made 16 packs (the 16 of «١٦-٣٠ كيلو»); then «وكمان بدي 3 من مقاس 5» landed on the size 6 line (4 × size 6), and «ناقص 3 بامبرز مقاس 5» took the size 6 off.
